<includeonly><onlyinclude>{{ResistanceDate/Reasoning|{{{1|{{{season|}}}}}}|{{{2|{{{episode|}}}}}}}}</onlyinclude></includeonly>

----

==Usage==
<pre><nowiki>{{ResistanceDate|season|episode}}</nowiki></pre>, where {{Para|season}} is 1, 2, "shorts," or "SWA" (without quotes), and {{Para|episode}} is an optional episode number or comic title.
